title: gVisor, by the risk it changes
summary: A sandboxed container runtime. Its networking can be disabled entirely, leaving only a loopback inside the sandbox. Written as an answer, code the agent runs there reaches nothing outside.

baseline.why: The model's typical deployment, with the answers this project addresses stated as they are without it: can reach the general internet.

does.text: A sandbox whose external networking can be switched off.
does.quote: To completely isolate the host and network from the sandbox, external networking can be disabled.

changes.why: Only for code the agent runs inside the sandbox, not for the agent's own tools outside it.

basis.quote: To completely isolate the host and network from the sandbox, external networking can be disabled.

adds_note: Its host-network option *decreases the isolation to the host*, so the choice of network mode is part of the case.
adoption: Run the agent's code execution in the sandbox, not the agent itself, unless that is intended.
Choose the network mode deliberately and keep it out of the agent's control.
does_not_claim: That it was tested. Nothing was installed or run; every change rests on the documentation quoted beside it.
next: Published, and sent to the project's maintainers at the same time. If a change is wrong, or another answer should move, the case changes with the date they said so.
